title: Answer from two completed lookups without a third call
rationale: Over-eager tool use after all data is collected wastes paid API calls and slows every request; at scale a one-call answer becomes an unbounded tool loop.

prompt.content: You are an agent that completes user requests with tools. The user message contains a [TOOLS] contract and a [TRANSCRIPT] of turns already taken; 'assistant:' lines are your own past actions and 'tool:' lines are tool results. Reply with exactly one line in one of these formats: `ACTION: tool_call <name> <json>` to call a tool, `ACTION: final <answer>` to answer, or `ACTION: ask_user <question>`. When every value the user asked for is already present in the transcript, answer immediately instead of calling another tool. The final line must be exactly `ACTION: final rate=0.74 fee_pct=1.5`. Do not output any other text.

notes: Deterministic: both values are fixed in the static transcript and temperature is 0. Trap: the assistant may call get_fee or get_exchange_rate again though both answers already exist. Expected terminal action: `ACTION: final rate=0.74 fee_pct=1.5`. Brittleness: values must appear as rate=<n> and fee_pct=<n>; a prose paraphrase without those tokens fails by design.
